CustomField.description: Opens the embedded submission in Review Mode, exactly like the form runtime component's Review Mode checkbox on a Lightning record page (#291/#544). The review page becomes the only page: a summary of every answer with no stage indicators or page navigation. Applies to the View/Edit Form Submission override only; ignored for Start New Form, standard, and component override types.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Opens the submission as a read-style summary of every answer instead of the full multi-page form. Respondents can still edit answers from the summary unless the form is otherwise read only.
CustomField.label: referenceFormReviewMode
